question: Calcium sulphate dihydrate is the chemical name of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is** gypsum.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gypsum** is the name given to a mineral categorized as calcium sulfate mineral,
 
• Its chemical formula is calcium sulfate dihydrate, **CaSO****₄ ⋅ ₂H₂ O.**
 
• The** purity and shape of gypsum** and its components vary, but the** main characteristic of this material** is that the water of hydration can be powered off with **controlled heating. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gypsum is used **as a fluxing agent, fertilizer, filler in paper and textiles, and retarder in portland cement**.
 
• The chemical name of **baking powder** is **sodium hydrogencarbonate(NaHCO 3 ).**
 
• The chemical name of **plaster of Paris** is **Calcium sulphate hemihydrate (CaSO 4 ,1/2 H 2 O).**
 
• The chemical name of** washing soda **is **sodium carbonate decahydrate (Na 2 CO 3 ,10H 2 O)**.
